Task: Inspect dataset and prove free-runtime feasibility
Acceptance criteria: Repeatable inventory accounts for 42 PDFs/109 pages, 13 recordings and the four 11-page scans, with hashes, extractor versions and decoded media metadata. Verify actual owned-worker model inference/resource fit and the separately selected free HF plans/access/quota/guarded stage path before claiming feasibility. Record unavailable permissions/quotas as specific blockers; no paid dependency or unverified CPU-Space assumption. Local scaffolding may proceed only under the delivery plan's explicit independent-work allowance.
Blocker: Gated AI4Bharat access pending; CUDA/model inference and HF provisioning/guarded integration unverified

Task: Scaffold application and local toolchain
Acceptance criteria: Frontend production build, API startup and liveness response pass. Clean setup is reproducible. Missing configuration is actionable; frontend assets contain no secret.

Task: Define contracts, domain rules and rubric
Acceptance criteria: Schema checks accept valid partial records and reject invalid ratings/evidence structures. Generated types match API contracts. Rubric arithmetic, unknown handling and domain/trade/cohort meanings are explicit.

Task: Implement database, durable stage leases and private storage
Acceptance criteria: Migrations apply cleanly and repeatably. Concurrent claims are exclusive; expired/replaced workers cannot checkpoint or publish with stale fencing values. History survives restart and duplicate publication is rejected. Database/storage policies, verified connection mode, bounded pools, free quotas and manual backup assumptions are documented.
Blocker: Local PG/RLS/fencing/recovery passed; hosted Supabase Free plan, connection and private-object operations unverified

Task: Implement authentication and authorization
Acceptance criteria: Two applicants and two cohorts prove allowed and denied access. Reject tampered/expired tokens and self-assigned privileges. Service keys remain server-side and absent from logs/assets.
Blocker: Local signatures/access/UI passed; actual Supabase signing, identities and hosted login/refresh unverified

Task: Implement uploads and submission APIs
Acceptance criteria: All required input formats preserve intact originals; 11-page scans are accepted. Reject spoofed/oversized files and another user attachment. Duplicate requests neither leak information nor create unintended duplicate work.

Task: Implement durable Postgres jobs and free-runtime dispatch
Acceptance criteria: A duplicate event, lost enqueue response, worker termination, late stale claimant and sleeping/offline runtime preserve accepted input and one published version. Progress exposes waiting_for_worker, waiting_for_runtime and quota_exhausted accurately. Real owned-worker claim/checkpoint recovery is verified separately from Gradio enqueue. Deterministic handlers prove orchestration only; no paid worker/broker is required.

Task: Implement self-hosted extraction and Indic translation
Acceptance criteria: Actual owned-model inference handles representative text and mixed-language examples with valid evidence and null unknowns. JSON repair is bounded and prompt injection is ignored. Measure peak memory, cold/warm time and quota failure behavior; paid endpoints are absent from the executed path.

Task: Train and evaluate our answer-relevance model
Acceptance criteria: Re-running with pinned data/features/seed reproduces the experiment. No holdout leakage and no synthetic-only real-world accuracy claim. Promotion gates use independently reviewed real data; insufficient labels or failed gates keep the baseline active and candidate experimental. The task may finish with a justified rejection, but the release must not advertise an unvalidated model as validated.

Task: Implement evidence-backed ratings and deterministic totals
Acceptance criteria: Exact arithmetic checks cover complete/partial/no-evidence/conflicting cases. Actual self-hosted outputs cite valid evidence or state insufficiency. Identity/grammar are excluded from scoring. Promoted versus baseline classifier selection is explicit and reproducible; no paid inference dependency.

Task: Build applicant submission and recording UI
Acceptance criteria: A signed-in applicant submits each supported type and sees persisted state; text reaches a real persisted assessment through T09/T12. PDF/audio processing not yet implemented is labeled waiting rather than completed. Refresh, upload failure and denied microphone have recovery paths. Mobile/keyboard checks pass and fixture results are labeled.

Task: Implement PDF and handwritten scans with open weights
Acceptance criteria: Evaluate complete, corrupted-text, mixed-language and overwritten cases plus a full 11-page Hindi scan. Original pages open correctly and uncertain handwriting is flagged. Restart/quota exhaustion resumes from saved pages. Record actual extraction quality and GPU scheduling versus execution time.

Task: Implement self-hosted regional audio transcription
Acceptance criteria: Run representative Hindi/Telugu/Bengali/Odia recordings on the actual selected owned runtime. Verify transcript/evidence alignment, memory and chunk latency; distinguish Hindi human validation from unvalidated other-language quality. Silence/invalid media and worker/quota/runtime interruption have bounded recovery. No paid ASR API is invoked; backend-specific measurements are not interchangeable.

Task: Build assessor workspace, evidence viewer and review
Acceptance criteria: All formats work from submit through source inspection/review. Correction creates a new version without losing prior evidence/actions. Stale edits and unauthorized evidence/review access are denied.

Task: Implement authorized similar-idea retrieval
Acceptance criteria: Annotated positive/hard-negative pairs yield measured Recall@5 and grounded reasons. Unauthorized candidates and own revisions never appear. Do not mix model versions/stale records or describe cosine similarity as probability/plagiarism.

Task: Implement free OpenStreetMap business context
Acceptance criteria: A real policy-compliant lookup shows source/area/time and approximate location. Empty results do not prove no competition. Timeout/rate-limit/poor-coverage states preserve the assessment; rate limiting is shared across API replicas. Offline snapshot labels and attribution are correct.

Task: Implement all four comparison views
Acceptance criteria: All four views match known aggregate fixtures. Empty/small groups, mixed rubrics and incomplete records do not generate misleading ranks. Filters/aggregates preserve cohort access boundaries and demo labels.

Task: Implement clarification and reassessment
Acceptance criteria: A real incomplete example receives useful questions and a response creates an evidence-linked revision. Repeated/stale answers do not duplicate/overwrite history. Coverage changes differ visibly from potential changes; never promise a higher score.

Task: Implement business arithmetic checks
Acceptance criteria: Tea example computes 120 x 10 x 25 = 30000 monthly revenue, never profit. Cover mixed periods, missing costs, decimal precision and ambiguous currency. Actual UI displays grounded checks with uncertainty preserved.

Task: Implement reports and version history
Acceptance criteria: Multipage reports are readable with required sections and honest unavailable states. Historical reports represent their own facts. Unauthorized access is denied; exports contain no secrets or reusable private-file access.

Task: Evaluate dataset and our model with real measurements
Acceptance criteria: Reports include real numerators/denominators per language/format and no family leakage. Distinguish owned open-weight inference from the project-trained classifier. Assess release gates honestly; missing reviewed data and unmet required quality gates remain visible. Never substitute hosted paid models to meet a target.
Blocker: Human review currently available only for English/Hindi; other language quality unvalidated

Task: Harden access, uploads and failure boundaries
Acceptance criteria: Resource access matrix passes including similarity/aggregates. Failures are bounded/actionable with no invented success or source-instruction execution. Secrets/private-data checks pass and relevant dependency findings are resolved or explicitly triaged.

Task: Measure portable API and model scalability
Acceptance criteria: Record real hardware and p50/p95/errors/cold starts/peak RAM/VRAM. Accepted jobs survive duplicate/crash recovery with one published result. No load test hits free Supabase/ZeroGPU/Nominatim/Overpass. Report infrastructure capacity separately from inference throughput; the free demo does not claim automatic horizontal GPU scaling.
Blocker: Local Docker engine unavailable during review; container scale checks not run

Task: Package zero-spend application deployment
Acceptance criteria: Clean local deployment works and API fits the selected free runtime budget. Manifests contain no paid worker, broker, domain, GPU or add-on. Configuration/quotas are verified; a zero-spend flag alone is not proof. Secrets stay out of images/assets and runtime files remain disposable.

Task: Package and deploy versioned model runtimes
Acceptance criteria: Use the eligible free account and prove owned model endpoints execute actual inference without paid APIs. Record cold/warm latency, peak RAM/VRAM, stage limits and quota attribution. Restart and model rollback preserve evidence and invalidate incompatible caches. Candidate classifier promotion/rejection is reflected in deployed config; runtime never trains on user requests.
Blocker: Required HF provisioning/model access unverified; publication approval absent

Task: Deploy and verify the full free hosted application
Acceptance criteria: Actual HTTPS login-to-assessment works with our own models and stored evidence. Verify private storage, CORS/auth, resume after sleeping runtimes and a quota-exhausted state. No paid API or service dependency is required; all claimed capabilities have live evidence.
Blocker: Service projects/access not verified; publication approval absent

Task: Run deployed acceptance and recovery checks
Acceptance criteria: Required journeys pass on recorded URL/release and blocking regressions are fixed. Recovery/rollback preserves inputs without duplicate published versions. Report actual measurements and any unverified language/provider behavior.

Task: Write final implementation and readiness handover
Acceptance criteria: Every done task has substantive report/passed evidence; blocked work stays visible. Setup and actual free deployment/model evidence are discoverable. Distinguish implemented/tested/deployed/future work; no readiness or scale claim exceeds evidence.

Task: Write detailed free-deployment walkthrough
Acceptance criteria: Every command references an existing file/tool and tested configuration; a clean-start rehearsal is recorded where possible. Actual verified steps, account/publication blockers and untested alternatives are distinguished. A new session can follow the guide without this chat. No secrets or invented deployment URL/results are included; publication requires explicit approval.
Blocker: Deployment configuration must be finalized and verified
